data.name: Negative Edge
data.detailed_description:
BECOME THE ULTIMATE WEAPON

Reconnaissance teams sent to the alien planet Solus have vanished without a trace.

Alioth, an elite soldier enhanced with experimental implants, is sent through an interdimensional jump to uncover their fate and neutralize the threat inhabiting the planet.

Armed with advanced firearms, a laser blade, powerful abilities, and a grappling hook, he must fight his way across a devastated alien world and confront the truth behind his mission.

Negative Edge is a fast-paced third-person action shooter that combines story-driven exploration, high-mobility combat, character progression, and intense arena encounters — all rendered in black, white, and blood red.

MASTER HYBRID COMBAT

Switch seamlessly between precise gunfire, devastating laser-blade attacks, and powerful combat abilities.

Use your full arsenal to react to different threats, break through enemy formations, and maintain control even when surrounded. Close the distance for aggressive melee attacks or reposition yourself before striking from range.

Combat rewards constant movement, rapid decision-making, and the ability to adapt under pressure.

CONTROL THE BATTLEFIELD

Your grappling hook is both a traversal tool and a weapon.

Cross large gaps, gain height, and move rapidly through the ruins of Solus. During combat, use it to close the distance or drag enemies directly into your attacks.

Execute brutal finishers to recover vital resources and keep fighting through overwhelming enemy assaults.

Every part of Alioth's kit is designed to keep you moving forward.

EXPLORE A HOSTILE ALIEN WORLD

Progress through a handcrafted, story-driven journey across the ruined world of Solus.

Explore canyons, alien structures, and the remains of an unknown civilization. Use your movement abilities to traverse vertical environments, reach distant platforms, and search beyond the main path.

Exploration sections lead into intense combat arenas, creating a continuous rhythm between traversal, discovery, and large-scale enemy encounters.

The deeper Alioth travels, the more the mission begins to unravel.

SURVIVE THE ARENAS

Enter dedicated combat zones and face structured waves of hostile alien forces.

Different enemy types attack simultaneously, forcing you to prioritize targets, manage your resources, and use the entire arena to your advantage.

Combine ranged attacks, melee combat, abilities, grappling-hook movement, and finishers to survive increasingly dangerous enemy formations.

Standing still is not an option.

SCAVENGE AND ADAPT

Defeated enemies reward you with coins that can be used to open ammunition, weapon, and armor chests throughout the world.

Weapons and armor are divided into five rarity tiers:

Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, and Legendary.

Each weapon can offer different attributes, including rate of fire, effective range, and magazine size. Armor modifies Alioth's capabilities through bonuses to attributes such as stamina, shields, walking speed, and sprinting speed.

Most chest contents are randomized, meaning powerful equipment can appear at any stage of the journey. Every discovery is a chance to adapt your loadout and change the way you approach the battles ahead.

FACE BIOMECHANICAL TITANS

Solus is home to threats far greater than the creatures roaming its ruins.

Face enormous biomechanical bosses built around multiple phases, evolving attacks, and increasingly dangerous combat patterns.

Victory demands more than raw firepower. Learn their behaviour, master your movement, and use every weapon and ability at your disposal.

UNCOVER THE TRUTH

Alioth's orders appear simple: locate the missing teams and eliminate any hostile alien presence.

But the ruins of Solus tell a different story.

Recover lost records, examine the remains of previous expeditions, and uncover the events that led to the planet's devastation.

Follow your orders.

Trust your commanders.

Become the ultimate weapon.

BLACK, WHITE & BLOOD

Experience a distinctive cinematic world defined by deep blacks, stark whites, and violent flashes of blood red.

Negative Edge's high-contrast visual style transforms every environment, attack, and enemy encounter into a brutal spectacle.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fast-paced third-person action combat

  • Hybrid fighting system combining gunplay, melee attacks, and abilities

  • Grappling hook for traversal, rapid repositioning, and enemy control

  • Brutal finishers that restore combat resources

  • Handcrafted, story-driven progression

  • Alternating exploration and arena-combat sections

  • Structured encounters with escalating enemy waves

  • Randomized weapon, armor, and ammunition chests

  • Equipment divided into five rarity tiers

  • Weapons and armor with different statistics and bonuses

  • Large-scale, multi-phase biomechanical bosses

  • Environmental storytelling and hidden records

  • Distinctive black, white, and blood-red visual style

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 (2.8 GHz) / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 (3.2 GHz)
  • Memory: 12 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB / AMD RX 560 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 (3.6 GHz) / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X (3.7 GHz)
  • Memory: 16 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 super 8 GB / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
